notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Major Changes[/h1]

[i]Below is a list of new features/changes that have been added to the game[/i]
[list] 
[*][h2]Wanted System[/h2] Jacob can get wanted for committing violent crimes. The longer Jacob goes on a crime spree, different Law Enforcement agencies will hunt him down, such as Police Officers, Swat Members, Federal Agents, and the Military. Hiding out of sight or disengaging from a violent crime spree will make the wanted level cool down.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/18421d8a5b0c4b89be1effb3a28d3432e27e4689.png[/img]

[h2]Drug Dealing[/h2] A new Trap House has been added next to the Main house, where Jacob can manufacture and sell drugs. To manufacture drugs, you must have $100 to start the process. Once finished Jacob will have 10 drugs in his Inventory which can be tracked on the bottom left of the screen. To sell drugs simply walk up to a Civilian to engage in a drug deal. Law Enforcement will be come hostile if you deal near them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/7a7e0c3e85ba8d8845319a71ca6bae8751ea1133.png[/img]

[h2]Car Dealership / Car Spawning[/h2] A new Car Dealership has been has been added next to the Carnival. (Blue dollar sign on map) There are multiple vehicles that can be purchased, along with the ability to spawn vehicles at owned properties. The color of the vehicle can be changed at the Dealership.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/da2fa6c2366104cd43e81b50a30f7e016fbbd8fa.png[/img]

[h2]Leveraged Crypto Trading[/h2]
A new option to trade Leveraged Crypto Futures has become available. From the pause menu or a gaming PC at a owned property, open the trading platform [i]BitCrest[/i]. From there Jacob can enter Long or Short positions speculating on price fluctuations in the Cryptocurrency Market with up to 100x Leverage, amplifying potential gains or losses.

 [i]Disclaimer: This game is for entertainment purposes only and does not simulate real-world trading conditions or provide financial, investment, or trading advice. All in-game currencies and assets are fictional, earned solely within the game, and have no real-world value or connection to actual cryptocurrencies. This game is not affiliated with or endorsed by any real-world trading platforms, exchanges, or financial institutions, despite any similarities. Real-world cryptocurrency trading carries significant risks, and you should consult a qualified financial advisor before participating."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/04570f537f727ef5543d71cfb07cf623abbed96b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/fe506ede310fb5d7803343eb0f5b71f8b3dbd863.png[/img]

[h2]Massive Performance and Optimization fixes[/h2] Optimization fixes increasing framerate and performance.

[h2]Updated User Interface[/h2]
Updated the Player UI, removed the stamina bar. Added a display showing the players amount of drugs. Added a new Mini Map with Icons to help navigate the Player, Story, Activities, and Side missions. Press M or Hold D Pad left to toggle full screen mode on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/2bc30d26bdc2285ab09bbb60df834a890701f197.png[/img]

[h2]Taxi Job[/h2]

Taxi Jobs can be completed if Jacob has a vehicle. Access the Taxi Jobs from the Pause Menu, then press Start Job. Pick up and drop off points will be assigned on the mini map, pick up the passengers and drop them off to earn cash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/050108deb83a9a6949578045b697ae0dfa29a4fa.png[/img]

[h2]Climbable Objects[/h2]

Jacob can now climb certain objects in the world such as light posts, certain buildings, certain fences, and electrical poles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/c7074406129a98a2b1ebdc98dcaa821d551d546e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/c7836568decbdfe37ac10a227d59a7a92a9c1624.png[/img]

[h2]Lawn Mowing Jobs[/h2]

New Lawn Mowing jobs have been added across the map. Simply speak with the Manager of the lawn company to accept the Job. Mow the overgrown spots to earn cash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/9ea37943cefd1c20164dee87130175a414807661.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/89fcaf577c2bc0aaf01ad0c9728cc1a4581c1bac.png[/img]

[h2]Radio Stations[/h2]

Radio Stations can be toggled On and Off with R or LB button when inside a vehicle or owned property. Change the song and adjust the volume to the music.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/3814eb22b2429994c69a8266090c259e81ed74fa.png[/img]

[h2]Dunk Tank Game at the Carnival[/h2]

A new Dunk Tank game has been added to the Carnival. Grab a ball and try to hit the target to drop the heckler in the tank!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/55c0e76c3b480273f844e6dad59e9fc30919fb44.png[/img]

[h2]Slot Machines[/h2]

Slot machines have been added to the Casino. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105995/ed79b1398d705854032f644f76c2bc9962676eec.png[/img]

[h1]Smaller Fixes + Quality of life Improvements[/h1]
[list]

[*]Huge Performance and Optimization fixes
[*]Replaced vehicle sounds with better sounding engines 
[*]Added option to skip the tutorial 
[*]Added BMX as a new vehicle
[*]Dealership POI
[*]Exclamation mark that changes color on Mini Map to indicate wanted status
[*]Car spawners at owned properties
[*]Story mode and Assassination missions now have Icons that display on the Mini Map for objectives
[*]Icons have been added to POI's on the map
[*]Increased AI distance to engage in shooting
[*]Reworked AI responses, AI now shoot faster, respond quicker when turning hostile, and are more accurate
[*]Adjusted Fist Fighting Combat distance for AI so they stopped stepping far back from the player in a fight
[*]Added a Trap House next to Jacobs house
[*]A BMX has replaced the starting car at Jacobs house
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could be killed during cutscenes
[*]Added a new input for Xbox controller when driving cars, RB now changes vehicle camera angles
[*]Added camera rotation with the right analog for vehicles 
[*]Added a new input so player can press R or LB in a vehicle or owned property to play music on the radio
[*]Hostile AI now shoot at Jacob while driving a vehicle
[*]Added a "You Died" Screen to load a saved game or quit
[*]Stopped vehicles from killing AI when not driving a vehicle
[*]Added the option to hide the Mini Map in the Experimental options
[*]Fixed First Person Mode from changing back to 3rd person mode when picking up weapons and doing graffiti
[*]Fixed an issue with audio being delayed when shooting guns and using explosives
[*]Increased Dalton attack frequency in the Tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed bugs in some side missions, Small Performance improvements, added higher betting limits on Roulette, Added lights on drivable cars, Fixed Graffiti Tags Reward; should now play cutscene on completion and reward in safehouse, Fixed a bug where you couldn't enter the Country Safehouse, Disabled player input while paused ( in testing ). 

Construction has started in the Countryside of Sterling Heights, a new shopping center is in the process of being built. Stay tuned for more updates!
